entities.name: Cytochrome c oxidase subunit 8B
observations: The 70-aa query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt Q863F9 (Carlito syrichta), annotated as mitochondrial cytochrome c oxidase subunit 8B.
Swiss-Prot homologs annotate this protein as a component of respiratory-chain complex IV in the mitochondrial inner membrane; Pfam COX8 (PF02285.21) matched residues 25–67.
Computed unmodified sequence properties: molecular mass 7,618.964 Da; theoretical pI 10.298; GRAVY 0.13; estimated charge at pH 7 is +5.6644.
